description: This file declares external functions related to applying patches to RTL826XB PHY hardware in a Linux driver, including patch application and initialization functions.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to a PHY device identified by unit and port parameters.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to PHY devices in either per-chip or per-bus mode.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init
methods.description: Initialize and retrieve the patch database for a specific PHY port.
